name: Caves of Koilos
description: A cave network on Dominaria, once a Thran prison, where Karn digs for the secret of the sylex.

timeline.summary: Karn repairs a broken excavator in the Caves of Koilos and recalls Jhoira doubting that the Phyrexians are on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Karn placed his hand on the excavator.

pages_say.description: A cave network on Dominaria, once a Thran prison, where Karn digs for the secret of the sylex.
The caves where Karn was buried.
The place where Karn found a clay tablet and perhaps gave away more of himself.
